description: Documents that could not be classified with sufficient confidence (< 0.60). Full text is extracted and operator manual classification is required.
notes: Documents classified as 'unknown' always require operator review. The operator should reclassify the document type in the UI after reviewing the extracted content.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Complete extracted text from the document. Structure and layout preserved where possible.

fields.name: detected_keywords
fields.description: Comma-separated list of significant keywords or phrases that may help identify the document type

fields.name: probable_document_type
fields.description: LLM's best guess at the document type based on content analysis, e.g. 'contract', 'certificate', 'letter'

fields.name: document_date
fields.description: Any date found in the document

fields.name: primary_entity
fields.description: The most prominently named person or organization in the document
